title: Skinny Bob video dismissed as CGI

tellings.quote: It's clearly CGI is like a [ __ ] dude. Like

plain: A musician known as Flying Lotus, talking with podcast host Jesse Michels about his interest in UFOs, discusses the Skinny Bob video, a clip passed around online that some people share as footage of an alien. He says it is clearly CGI, meaning computer-generated imagery, and brushes it off, showing that even fans of the subject reject some of what circulates.
